decisions.reason: The source requires image and information display in Rabby's wallet NFT view; it does not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear on the dashboard.
The wallet presentation issue does not change the dashboard's required referral, ticket, or prize summary data.
NFT image and information visibility in a wallet does not alter public mint counts or next-draw statistics.
The source reports missing general wallet image and information but does not change the required Small Block or Big Block metadata ticket counters.
The source concerns presentation of an NFT in Rabby and does not change fiat buyers' wallet provisioning, dashboard access, commissions, tickets, or prize-access behavior.
The wallet display observation does not change the Transak provider, payment methods, fiat conversion, or automatic mint flow.
The source does not change the certificate email, its contents, or its primary read action.
The Rabby wallet observation does not request any FAQ copy revision.
The missing image is in a wallet NFT view, not the independently specified landing-page book-cover presentation.
Wallet NFT presentation does not change email or magic-link authentication or the dashboard areas accessible through it.
The source does not change referral qualification, commission amount, recipient, timing, or wallet payment behavior.
NFT image and metadata visibility in Rabby does not change the optional offline PDF download link or its presentation.
